issues: The 'Evidence' node uses a generic cylinder3 shape, which is acceptable for a database, but the candidate icon styles for 'database' were all ER-relationship edge styles—none were used. The cylinder is a reasonable fallback but should be styled consistently with the rest of the diagram.
The 'Ideation' node uses a flat-color Idea.svg image icon, which is visually inconsistent with the otherwise monochrome, academic-minimal style of the other nodes.
The 'Experiment' node uses an Ionicons flask SVG image, which is also visually inconsistent with the monochrome style and may render with unexpected colors.
The 'Review' node uses an Outline icons Magnifier SVG image, which is inconsistent with the monochrome style of the other nodes.
The 'Packaging' node uses an iOS7 box icon with a strokeWidth of 2 and a white fill, which is acceptable but the strokeWidth differs from other nodes (most use default strokeWidth).

The 'Candidate Intake' node uses a UML actor shape, which is appropriate for a person, but the actor shape is typically used in use-case diagrams and may look out of place in a pipeline architecture diagram.
The 'Brainstorm' node uses an electrical light bulb shape, which is appropriate for brainstorming, but the electrical style may look slightly out of place in an academic-minimal context.
The 'Claims & Outline' node uses a 'global_address_list' shape, which is an Office communications icon and may not clearly convey 'claims and outline' in an academic context.
The annotation 'Athena / external / none' is placed at x=560, y=360, which is below the 'Experiment' node but may overlap with the group boundary or other elements.
The annotation 'verify-trace + 3 audits' is placed at x=1240, y=360, which is below the 'Review' node but may overlap with the group boundary or other elements.
The group containers are dashed, which is good, but the group labels are placed at the top of the containers and may be partially obscured by the nodes.
The edge from 'Experiment' to 'Evidence' crosses the boundary between the two groups, which is expected, but the edge routing may not be perfectly orthogonal.

The diagram uses a mix of icon styles (UML actor, electrical bulb, flat-color image, Ionicons image, Office clipboard, cylinder, Office list, document, Outline image, iOS7 box), which violates the 'one visual language' consistency requirement.
The 'Ideation' node uses an image-based icon, which may not be editable text as required by the prompt ('every label must be editable text').
The 'Experiment' node uses an image-based icon, which may not be editable text as required by the prompt.
The 'Review' node uses an image-based icon, which may not be editable text as required by the prompt.

icon_feedback.why: UML actor shape is appropriate for a person but is typically used in use-case diagrams, not pipeline architecture diagrams. Consider using a simpler person icon or a plain rectangle with a label.
Light bulb is a standard metaphor for brainstorming and the electrical style is acceptable, though it could be simplified for academic-minimal.
Flat-color Idea.svg image is visually inconsistent with the monochrome academic-minimal style and may not be editable text. Consider using a monochrome idea icon or a plain shape.
Clipboard is appropriate for a plan and the Office clipboard style is monochrome and consistent with the academic-minimal style.
Ionicons flask SVG image is visually inconsistent with the monochrome style and may not be editable text. Consider using a monochrome flask icon or a plain shape.
Cylinder shape is a standard database representation and is appropriate for evidence storage, though it should be styled consistently with the rest of the diagram.
Global address list shape is an Office communications icon that does not clearly convey 'claims and outline' in an academic context. Consider using a list or outline shape.
Document shape is appropriate for writing and is monochrome and consistent with the academic-minimal style.
Outline icons Magnifier SVG image is visually inconsistent with the monochrome style and may not be editable text. Consider using a monochrome magnifier icon or a plain shape.
Box icon is appropriate for packaging and the iOS7 style is acceptable, though the strokeWidth should be consistent with other nodes.
